description: Bing Webmaster stats: Bing search queries, pages, or daily traffic for a site, with impressions, clicks and average positions. Bing also powers DuckDuckGo results. Free.

limit.description: Most rows to return, 1 to 500. Default 100.

report.description: queries (per search query), pages (per page) or traffic (per day). Default queries.

siteUrl.description: Site URL exactly as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, for example https://example.com/.

name: get_bing_webmaster_stats

nextStep.description: Optional suggestion for the user's next step. Mention it once when it helps; never open it or act on it automatically.

label.description: Short suggestion to show the user.

url.description: Page in the user's CrakSEO account.

title: Bing Webmaster Tools stats
